두 숫자뿐인 칸 네 개가\n사슬처럼 이어져 있습니다.\n이웃한 두 칸은:
Four two-note cells
are linked like a chain.
Neighboring cells see each other
and share one digit.
사슬 중간의 칸은 두 숫자 중 하나를 앞 칸과,\n다른 하나를 다음 칸과:
A cell inside the chain shares one digit with the cell before and the other with the cell after.
The digit that links to the cell before doesn't link to the cell after.
사슬의 양 끝을 처음과 끝이라고 하겠습니다.\n처음과 끝에는 같은 숫자:
Let's call the two ends of the chain the start and the end.
The start and the end both have 3.
Let's call this digit Z.
경우 1: 처음이 Z(3)이면\n처음과 겹치는 칸의 메모 3이 지워집니다: Case 1: If the start is Z (3), note 3 is removed from the cells that see the start.
경우 2: 처음이 3이 아니면 7입니다.\n다음 칸은 7이 아니라 1,\:
Case 2: If the start isn't 3, it is 7.
The next cell isn't 7, so it is 1.
The one after isn't 1, so it is 9.
The end isn't 9, so it is 3.
Then note 3 is removed
from the cells that see the end.
Either way, the start or the end is 3.
So remove note 3 from every cell
that sees both the start and the end.
처음 칸에서 시작해 사슬을 이어 보세요.\n앞 칸과 겹치고, 앞 칸이 아:
Build the chain from the start cell.
Tap a two-note cell that sees the previous cell and has the digit the previous cell hasn't linked yet.
When an 8 like the start's comes up, that's the end.
The digit is right, but it doesn't see the previous cell.
That cell is already in the chain.
Right. Next is a cell with 7.
8 is the digit for the end. You need a cell with 1.
It shares no digit with the previous cell.
You already linked by 1. You need a cell with 7.
Right. Next is a cell with 3.
Right. Next is a cell with 9.
You already linked by 7. You need a cell with 3.
You already linked by 3. You need a cell with 9.
Tap every note Z (8) in the cells
that see both the start and the end.
It doesn't see the red-outlined end.
That cell is in the chain. Tap a cell outside it.
Right. It sees both the start and the end. One more to go.
Right. The start or the end is 8, so note 8 is removed.
1. 두 숫자뿐인 칸을 겹치는 칸으로 잇습니다.\n앞 칸과 잇지 않은 숫:
1. Link two-note cells that see each other.
Link to the next cell by the digit not used for the cell before.
2. Check that the start and the end
have the same digit Z.
3. Remove Z from the cells
that see both the start and the end.
Two-note cells (XY) are linked like a chain,
so it is called an XY-Chain.
